target_customer: Individual resellers in Brazil (mostly women) who sell beauty and wellness products through WhatsApp and social media, and the digital-first brands that supply them
problem: Millions of Brazilians resell products through fragmented offline channels without modern infrastructure, credit or catalog access, and need low-cost entry without upfront investment.
business_model: Reseller marketplace with take rate on sales plus embedded microcredit and installment payments
product_category: Social commerce reseller marketplace with embedded credit

founders.name: Luis Felipe Franco
founders.background_notes: 13 plus years of entrepreneurship; created the Scale-up Endeavor program; ran growth at DTC beauty brand Sallve

founders.name: Marcelo Canovas
founders.background_notes: Led marketing and digital product at Liv Up

founders.name: Ilana Nasser
founders.background_notes: Former Director of Network Engagement at Endeavor Brazil

founders.name: Pedro Pedruzzi
founders.background_notes: Engineering from embedded software to distributed systems

competitors.name: Natura and Avon consultant networks
competitors.what: Direct-selling networks of beauty consultants with social selling tools
competitors.traction_then: About 1.5 million consultants; 750 thousand used social selling tools in 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace, logistics integration and a credit scoring engine for first-time sellers are standard engineering with hard risk modeling in credit.

defensibility.rationale: Reseller community and a proprietary credit engine could create stickiness, but incumbents with million-consultant networks and marketplaces can serve the same sellers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Natura and Avon later opened Shopee stores for consultants (reported July 2026); no copy of the credit-plus-marketplace model found.

market_need_then: Brazil is a large beauty market and direct selling was moving to social commerce in 2022, with millions of informal sellers, per Brazilian press; the YC page cites a market of about 30 billion dollars.

identity.logo: A logo image exists on profiles; no design description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Motivational and aspirational, warm and community focused ('Realize seus sonhos')

branding.community_and_virality: More than 45,000 resellers claimed on the site; Reclame Aqui complaints in 2025 about delivery and refunds, with a 7.3 of 10 average

brand_strength.rationale: Name likely echoes vender (to sell) though no source says so; reseller community of 45,000 but mixed consumer-complaint reputation and little brand press.

pivots.from: WhatsApp resale of kitchen, home and baby items to women
pivots.to: Marketplace of digital-first beauty brands with embedded microcredit
pivots.why: Company says traction accelerated after pivoting to a marketplace plus credit model; Reclame Aqui replies in 2025 say the catalog now focuses on beauty, health and wellness

outcome_analysis: Vendah raised a pre-seed in 2021, joined YC in Winter 2023, raised a R$12 million seed in August 2023, and later pivoted from home goods to beauty with credit, claiming 45,000 resellers and 30 percent monthly GMV growth. It stated a goal of a 2024 Series A but none was found, so the story is a promising but unproven pivot.
notes: Pre-seed amount reported as R$8.5 million (Maya Capital lead); Seedtable gives 1.6M USD, one aggregator, so USD left null. Seed lead conflict: most sources say Y Combinator, geo.sig.ai says Goodwater. Total funding varies by aggregator (CB Insights 6.66M, PitchBook 4.47M). Pivot date not stated by sources. Headcount estimates conflict (PitchBook 44, Crustdata 109, YC 8).
